data.name: Datha
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Datha is a goddess of fertility and motherhood. This name is derived from the Greek word 'dosis' meaning 'gift' or 'grace'. In Christianity, Datha symbolizes the divine gift of new life and the blessings of motherhood.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine gift of new life and blessings.
